North Clackamas Aquatic Park

Welcome to North Clackamas Aquatic Park, where we’ve been making waves for over 30 years! More than just an oasis for aquatic fitness and fun, the Aquatic Park is also a community resource for water safety and swim lessons.

7300 S.E. Harmony Rd, Milwaukie, OR 97222
Office Hours Only Mon/Wed: 6 a.m.-8 p.m. Tue/Thu: 8:30 a.m.-8 p.m. Fri: 6 a.m.-12:30 p.m. Sat/Sun: 8:30 a.m.-3:30 p.m.

Phone: 503-557 SURF (7873)

Explore Aquatic Programs

Rain or shine, you can dive into fun at the North Clackamas Aquatic Park—where it is always 86 degrees year-round. Choose from a variety of recreation, fitness, and water education programs for all ages. Learn more about the benefits of getting an Annual Membership.

Know Before You Go

What to Bring
Don’t forget your swimsuit, towel, snacks and water bottle for a comfortable day at the Aquatic Park.
Safety Guidelines
Children 9 years and younger must be accompanied in the water by a responsible supervisor 13 years of age or older at all times (supervisor ratio of 1:3 for children 3-9 years; ratio of 1:2 for children 0-2 years).
Free Lockers
Complimentary lockers are included with all admissions, with a $5 deposit or photo ID per key.
Riding the Slides
Swimmers must be at least 4 feet tall and 250 lbs. or less to ride the water slides.
Rock Wall
Participants must weigh over 45 lbs. and less than 200 lbs.
